name: bingo-app
description: Bingo application with NestJS backend and Angular frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:network: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend:network"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd frontend && npm test
